results.content: With the midterm elections just weeks away, new polls show the president facing some of the weakest approval ratings of his political career, raising fresh questions about whether the GOP can hold onto its narrow congressional majorities. results.content: With highly contested midterm elections in a few weeks, President Donald Trump again sees his approval rating stuck at a career-low in Reuters/Ipsos polling, which also indicated cratering support from Hispanic voters.
